item.title: Haha to Kodomobeya Oji-san no 1￮ Nenkan no Nariyuki to, Sorekara.
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Gekkan Toshiue Milk Tank
  • 発売日: 2021-09-24
  • スコア: 6.88/10 (58 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 母と子供部屋おじさんの1○年間の成り行きと、それから。
  • 英語名: Haha to Kodomobeya Oji-san no 1￮ Nenkan no Nariyuki to, Sorekara.

あらすじ

At thirty, Yoshizawa Hiroto, the man still living in his childhood room…

And his mother, Yoshizawa Rie, with whom he shares a secret relationship…

How did their current relationship come to be…

This story traces their secret bond with his mother—past, present, and beyond— delving into his past, starting from his elementary school days when he attended school normally despite his introverted nature.
